{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a premium static restaurant website for \"Salon Table\", a concept restaurant located inside a modern beauty salon / wellness studio. The site should feel like a clean Swiss editorial layout mixed with a stylish hospitality landing page. Use only vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, no backend, no database, no login, no reservations API, no real maps, no external live data. Static/mock/sample content is totally fine. The design direction should be inspired by the clarity of Wikipedia-style informational pages: structured sections, clean typography, factual blocks, references-style notes, table-like menu details, and readable long-form content, but make it visually premium and restaurant-ready rather than plain. Overall Style: Swiss design system, strong grid, lots of white space, black/cream/soft beige palette, precise typography, thin rules, modular cards, editorial captions, minimal icons, elegant parallax image bands, subtle hover effects. Website should be fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Create a complete one-page static site with the following sections: 1) Hero Section: full screen or tall hero with a refined salon-restaurant image placeholder, large headline \"Salon Table — Dining Between Beauty & Ritual\", short subtitle about a seasonal cafe and small plates menu inside a boutique salon, two CTA buttons \"View Menu\" and \"Plan a Visit\". Add a small Swiss-style info badge: Est. 2026 / Seasonal Menu / Private Tastings. Include subtle parallax background movement on scroll. 2) Editorial Intro: a Wikipedia-inspired article header style with title, short summary, quick facts panel, and small table of contents links. Include static facts such as cuisine type, atmosphere, hours, signature dish, price range, location area. 3) About / Concept: explain the restaurant concept: guests can enjoy herbal teas, lunch bowls, pastries, and evening tasting plates while visiting the salon. Layout should use two-column editorial text with pull quote, image placeholder, and numbered annotations. 4) Menu Section: create elegant static menu tables/cards with categories: Morning Rituals, Lunch Plates, Salon Tea Service, Sweet Counter, Evening Small Plates. Each item should have name, short description, price, dietary tag like vegan/gluten-free/spicy. Do not fetch anything externally; hardcode sample menu items. 5) Featured Dish Parallax Story: a large parallax strip focusing on a signature dish like \"Citrus Herb Rice Bowl\" with layered text blocks and a small ingredient list. 6) Experience Section: three or four modular cards describing \"Before Appointment\", \"After Treatment\", \"Private Salon Supper\", \"Weekend Brunch\". Use Swiss grid layout and minimalist line icons made with CSS or simple text symbols. 7) Wikipedia-Style Knowledge Panel: create a right-side or card-based info box similar to an encyclopedia infobox, including founded, chef, design style, seating, best for, menu format, accessibility, payment note. Keep it fictional/static. 8) Interior Gallery: static image placeholders or CSS gradient blocks for salon cafe counter, dining nook, tea bar, pastry shelf, evening table. Add parallax or scroll reveal effect but keep it lightweight and vanilla JS. 9) Hours & Visit: clean section with opening hours, address placeholder, contact placeholder, and a simple static note that reservations are by phone only. Do not create booking functionality. Include a non-interactive map-style block made with CSS only, not Google Maps. 10) Press / Notes: editorial references-style list such as \"Seasonal menu updated monthly\", \"Ingredients sourced from local farms\", \"Salon services not included in dining prices\". It should visually reference Wikipedia citation style but be original. 11) Footer: minimal footer with logo wordmark, navigation anchors, address, social text links, and copyright. Functional Requirements: Use vanilla HTML/CSS/JS in separate files if possible. Smooth anchor scrolling. Parallax effects on hero and featured sections using CSS/JS only. Mobile menu can be a simple toggled nav, no authentication. Use accessible semantic HTML, alt text, good contrast, keyboard-friendly buttons/links. Keep animations refined and not too flashy. Add CSS variables for colors, spacing, fonts. Use placeholder images via gradients or local-style placeholders, not external APIs. The final result should look like a polished static website mockup ready to open in a browser.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
